geometry.capitalAssembly: Flared daito, opposed half-lapped first cross, four seated second-course arms, four makito, half-lapped receiver pair, cheek keys. Existing capital foot and receiver top retain prior anchors.
geometry.lowerShaft: Existing stone plinth and radius retained; shaft is trimmed to existing capital foot at local y5.19 rather than penetrating first arms. Radial resolution48.
geometry.relief: Convex lobed closed leaves, capped stems, cast floral fittings and shaped shoulder carving; no relief texture or full-scene plate.
geometry.portal: Original frame/opening extents retained; layered timber moldings and solid foliage relief replace thin repeated outlines.
